description: Defines an abstract class ResourceLoader for dynamically loading resources, including methods for reading XML configurations, caching, and instantiating resource loader classes based on XML definitions.

classes.name: ResourceLoader
classes.description: An abstract class for loading resources with support for XML configuration, caching, and dynamic class instantiation.

methods.name: loadResource
methods.description: Abstract method to load a resource as InputStream given a location.

methods.name: getURL
methods.description: Abstract method to get the URL of a resource given a location.

methods.name: getLoader
methods.description: Retrieves a ResourceLoader instance from cache or creates it based on XML configuration.

methods.name: readXmlRootElement
methods.description: Reads and returns the root element of an XML document.

methods.name: readXmlDocument
methods.description: Reads and returns an XML Document object from a resource filename.

methods.name: invalidateDocument
methods.description: Clears caches related to a specific XML filename.

methods.name: makeLoader
methods.description: Creates a ResourceLoader instance based on XML element configuration.
